subject.en: Copper rooster lifting one foot beside a multicolored morning glory
subject.zh: 铜金色公鸡抬起一只脚，靠近一朵多彩牵牛花

description.en: A rooster pauses halfway through a step and turns toward a morning-glory flower. Its comb, full tail and toes form one complete, compact animal.
description.zh: 公鸡迈步途中停下，转向一朵牵牛花。鸡冠、完整尾羽与脚趾构成紧凑而完整的主体。

description.en: Copper and ochre planes lead, with a natural red comb and deep green tail. One faceted flower carries the small multicolored interest point.
description.zh: 铜金与赭黄色面成为主调，配自然红色鸡冠和深绿尾羽。唯一的多彩兴趣点集中在一朵切面花上。

description.en: Low stepped paper terraces cross a warm ochre field. Their different heights give a quiet sunrise rhythm without creating a literal landscape.
description.zh: 低矮的阶梯纸面横穿温暖赭色底纹，不等高的层次带来日出般的节奏，保持图标界面的简洁。

sizeNote.en: The complete animal and accessory have at least 172.5 px clearance from the actual rounded outline. Ten export sizes preserve one uniform placement. Small app/browser marks use the transparent foreground; fine facets and accessory details simplify at 16 px.
sizeNote.zh: 完整动物和兴趣点距离真实圆角轮廓至少 172.5 px。十种导出尺寸保持同一组等比位置，小型 UI 与浏览器使用透明主体；细小切面和装饰细节在 16 px 时会简化。

goal.en: Chat with a locally configured Hermes Agent in a browser, inspect streamed replies and tool activity, and keep searchable session history on your machine.
goal.zh: 通过浏览器与本机配置的 Hermes Agent 对话，查看流式回复和工具执行过程，并在本地保存可搜索的会话记录。
